messages:
Maya: Heads-up: noticed a handful of tenants showing negative per-token after cache credits applied in the cost dashboard. PMs are asking why billing looks like a refund. :confused:
Leo: yep caught that in last night's rollup. it's coming from prefetch amortization + late eviction refunds stacking.
Priya: quick repro on staging if anyone wants to try:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/econ/sim -d '{"route":"/v1/respond","chain":["edge","nlg"],"prefetch":true,"evict_window":120}'
```
Owen: TL;DR: we currently emit a single cache_credit field with no lineage. first-owner gets amortized credit, then when the cache hit is realized we apply a refund which sometimes flips net_cost negative for small tenants.
Maya: UX ask: can we surface both numbers? like show raw_token_cost and net_cost (post-credits) side-by-side, and hide weird negative nuts behind a tooltip that explains amortization?
Leo: data change needed: add credit_source enum + short lineage_hash so we can tie refunds to originating prefetches. keep both optional to avoid cardinality explosion. e.g. credit_source: "prefetch" | "evict_refund" | "manual" and lineage_hash: short hex string.
Priya: sampling strategy: deterministic sample by tenant_id at 2% default. keep 100% for canaries/org-paid. sampled events include lineage_hash + full trace. non-sampled keep only aggregate numbers.
Owen: console side: add toggle "include amortized prefetch credits" + a small explainer card. also add CTA "show sampled traces" which calls econ/trace?lineage=<hash> and returns sampled chain events.
Maya: operational guardrails: exclude canary traffic from amortized pools (treat as cold) so experiments don't skew tenant unit economics. also alert: route-level 95p net_cost < 0 for >10m -> dry-run first, then page if persistent.
Leo: storage note: lineage_hash is 8 bytes hex, credit_source enum keeps cardinality small. with 2% sampling estimates look reasonable. will send numbers later.
Priya: plan of record:
- Priya: schema change PR (optional credit_source, lineage_hash, explicit cache_credit numeric).
- Leo: sampling rollout config + storage estimate (2% default, deterministic by tenant).
- Owen: console toggle + "show sampled traces" CTA + tooltip copy.
- Maya: RFC for canary exclusion + alert dry-run checklist.
Maya: thanks team. i'll schedule a 20m quick sync after PRs land. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: econ-service v2.14.1 deployed to staging (hash: a7b9c3d)
Owen: i'll mock the trace endpoint contract and post it in #eng-api.
Priya: opening schema PR now, adding migration notes.
Leo: posting sampling estimates in the channel in ~30m.
